decision: Deliver T-0127 as a wrapper over existing primitives plus a thin vendor-side key-verification layer that lives ONLY at the vendor-service boundary, never in core. (A) Genesis installer `ops/install.sh` — one POSIX-bash, idempotent, fail-closed, online/linux-amd64 (MVP) script: (1) Preflight before any mutation — assert docker + `docker compose` v2, free default host ports 55432/8180/9000/8082/3000, free disk; on failure exit != 0, print the failing precondition, nothing brought up (F-7/AC-5). (2) One config — if `.env.prod` absent, generate it from `.env.prod.example` filling every REPLACE_WITH_* with a secure random (`openssl rand`) and wiring the shared Postgres password into DATABASE_URL; if `.env.prod` exists, leave it untouched (F-2/F-5/AC-3/AC-4). `.env.prod` is the SINGLE required config source. (3) Activation key optional — if provided via `--key` or CHOROS_ACTIVATION_KEY, write to `config/activation/activation.key` (gitignored); if absent, installation proceeds without error (F-10) and the circuit comes up in autonomous mode. (4) Bring-up — `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.prod up -d --wait`; migrations (incl. 026 genesis-owner) run by the existing `ops/docker-entrypoint.sh` -> `migrations/run.mjs` BEFORE app start — no second owner-creation path (F-3/F-4). (5) Verify — `GET /health` == 200 else fail-closed (F-6/AC-1), no false-green circuit. (6) Self-upgrade (same script, MVP) — re-run with `--upgrade` or existing `.env.prod` does `docker compose pull` (online) + `up -d --wait`; migrations idempotently catch up via the entrypoint (silo-upgrade semantic). Air-gapped/ARM = Stage-2, explicitly out of MVP. (7) Structured result — endpoint, how to log in as first owner (e-owner/tenant-owner), image version, activation status (active|autonomous) (F-6/AC-10). (B) Activation key format `choros-key.v1` — detached-signature envelope, offline-verifiable: wire `choros1.<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(sig)>`; payload = canonical JSON ActivationKey (circuit_id=identity, entitlements[]=service flags, not_before/not_after=term, issued_at, vendor, key_version); sig = Ed25519 over payload by the vendor private key, verified against a vendor PUBLIC key shipped with the image (`config/activation/vendor-pub.ed25519`) WITHOUT any network call (NF-2 offline; otherwise mandatory call-home = hidden kill-switch). Forgery/expiry is detected locally by signature + not_after but only changes the entitlement verdict, never starts anything in core. (C) Entitlement effect boundary — the key parser/verifier lives in `src/vendor/activation.ts`, a SEPARATE module outside `src/core/`, read only by the vendor layer (`src/vendor/`) and vendor HTTP edges (`src/http/vendor-*`), which is exactly the circuit<->control-plane boundary (fleet-ops ADR §2). On expired/missing/forged key the vendor layer returns a refusal ON the vendor-service call (updates / agentic maintenance / control-plane sync) -> HTTP 402/403 on `vendor-*` endpoints (F-11/AC-8). Core (`src/core/`: PDP, grant-resolver, processes/bridge, timers, audit, actor-event, RLS) does NOT import or read key status/term — RED-LINE, enforced statically (FF-T127-1). All four SPEC blocking questions (Q-1..Q-4) are resolved by the founder's 2026-06-13 licensing decisions: key sells the service layer (Q-1: entitlement gates only vendor-service calls), MVP = online/x86_64/self-upgrade (Q-2 single linux/amd64 target, offline images Stage-2; Q-3 installer is also the upgrader for online self-upgrade), key carries identity itself with offline-verifiable vendor signature (Q-4 bootstrap of trust = signature, not call-home).

rejected_alternatives.option: License daemon / runtime expiry-timer inside src/core/ that halts or degrades the circuit when the key is missing/expired/revoked
rejected_alternatives.why_not: This IS the kill-switch the founder red-lined (NF-1/NF-2). A circuit must never go down because of billing. Directly forbidden — and FF-T127-1 makes the absence of any such core branch a CI invariant.

rejected_alternatives.option: Mandatory online activation as a precondition of install/start (call-home before the stack runs)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: No network (or control-plane down) would mean no working circuit — a covert kill-switch via availability. Violates NF-2 offline-friendly and the founder decision that an expired/absent key = autonomous mode, not failure. Activation stays optional and by-request (F-10).

rejected_alternatives.option: JWT (RS256) as the key format via a JWT library
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Pulls a JWT dependency and a claim zoo for a single-purpose token. A detached Ed25519 envelope is ~40 lines zero-dep on node:crypto and is more proportionate; it also keeps verification trivially offline and auditable.

rejected_alternatives.option: Read the key in a global request middleware (even 'only for telemetry')
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Places key-status reads on the core hot path, makes FF-T127-1 dishonest, and creates the temptation for future gating. The key is read ONLY in src/vendor/ and vendor HTTP edges; core never sees it.

rejected_alternatives.option: Installer ships its own forked compose/stack in an installer subtree
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates NF-4 (one artifact, mode=config — tenancy ADR §7) and AC-12. The installer parametrizes the EXISTING docker-compose.yml + prod overlay + migrations/run.mjs; no duplicate stack, no src/ fork.

rejected_alternatives.option: Bake the activation key (or vendor private key) into the image / commit it
rejected_alternatives.why_not: RL-1/RL-3 secret discipline (NF-3): only the vendor PUBLIC key ships with the image; the activation.key is a runtime artifact under config/activation/*.key which is gitignored. The vendor PRIVATE signing key never enters the client circuit at all (key issuance is control-plane, OS-3).

contracts: ops/install.sh: POSIX-bash, set -euo pipefail; phases preflight -> config -> (optional key) -> bring-up -> verify -> [self-upgrade] -> summary; exit 0 iff GET /health == 200; exit != 0 with the failing step name on any precondition/bring-up/verify failure (no partial false-green). Uses ONLY `docker compose` + the existing prod overlay + migrations via entrypoint; no second genesis-owner path; no src/ fork.

Activation key wire format `choros-key.v1`: 'choros1.<base64url(canonical-json payload)>.<base64url(ed25519 sig)>'; payload schema = ActivationKey object_model; canonical JSON = sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8.

verifyKey(envelope: string, vendorPubKey: Uint8Array, now: Date): ActivationStatus — PURE function in src/vendor/activation.ts; zero-dep (node:crypto Ed25519 verify); NO network, NO DB, NO process.env inside the verifier (env boundary stays in composition root); returns state 'active' iff signature valid AND not_before <= now < not_after, 'autonomous' iff valid signature but expired OR key missing, 'invalid' iff signature mismatch/parse error. A forged/expired key NEVER throws into a core path.

Dependency direction invariant: src/vendor/** MAY import src/core/**; src/core/** MUST NOT import src/vendor/** and MUST NOT read activation/license/entitlement status. This one-way edge is the executable form of the no-kill-switch red-line (FF-T127-1).

src/http/vendor-activation.ts: GET /vendor/activation returns ActivationStatus (200 always — reporting the verdict is not gating); vendor-service endpoints (updates/agentic-ops/control-plane-sync, src/http/vendor-*) return 402/403 when entitlement absent/expired — refusal lands ON the vendor call, user endpoints stay 200 (AC-8).

config/activation/: vendor-pub.ed25519 (public key, shipped with image, committed); activation.key (runtime, gitignored via config/activation/*.key in .gitignore); the vendor PRIVATE signing key never enters the client circuit.
.env.prod.example: extended with an optional `# CHOROS_ACTIVATION_KEY=` (commented, no value) documenting that an absent key => autonomous mode; no secret committed (RL-3).
Migration 026 reused verbatim — installer introduces NO new owner-creation path (SPEC §5 invariant).
docs/runbooks/install.md: the one documented command (AC-1), preconditions, the autonomous-vs-active explanation, and the first-owner login note.
package.json: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh and ci/checks/no-killswitch-in-core.sh added to the fitness script chain.
No edits to src/core/*, agents/, constitution/, control-plane.

fitness_functions.rule: RED-LINE (no kill-switch in core): no file under src/core/ reads activation/license/entitlement status or term, and no file under src/core/ imports src/vendor/. There is no core branch that halts/degrades the circuit on key state. Comment-only mentions are permitted.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/no-killswitch-in-core.sh (set -euo pipefail, self-tested like no-env-in-core.sh): strip comment-only lines from every src/core/**/*.ts, then FAIL if any code line matches -iE 'activation|entitlement|license|killswitch|kill_switch|not_after|verifyKey' OR imports from '\.\./vendor|src/vendor|/vendor/'. Self-test 1: a planted core file importing src/vendor must be detected (else exit 2). Self-test 2: a comment-only mention must NOT match (else exit 2). Exit 0 clean, 1 violation, 2 self-test broken. (AC-6)

fitness_functions.rule: Installer = wrapper, not a fork: install.sh references the existing docker-compose.yml + docker-compose.prod.yml + migrations/run.mjs; there is no duplicate compose/stack and no src/ fork in the installer tree.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh: assert ops/install.sh exists; grep that it invokes `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml`; assert no second docker-compose*.yml under ops/ or an installer subtree; assert install.sh does NOT contain genesis-owner SQL (no second owner path — migration 026 only). FAIL on any. (AC-12)

fitness_functions.rule: Key verifier is offline and zero-dep: src/vendor/activation.ts imports only node builtins (node:crypto, etc.), performs no network call, no DB, no process.env read inside the verifier function.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh step: grep src/vendor/activation.ts imports are node:* only (no http/https/fetch/pg/axios); grep no 'fetch('/'https?\.'/'new Client'/'process.env' in the verify path. FAIL on any. Backs NF-2 offline + the 'no hidden call-home kill-switch' property. (AC-9)

fitness_functions.rule: Entitlement gates ONLY vendor endpoints: refusal on missing/expired key occurs on src/http/vendor-* endpoints (402/403); user-facing endpoints (auth/processes/inbox/audit/rights/grants) have no entitlement/activation read.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh step: grep that activation/entitlement reads appear ONLY in src/vendor/** and src/http/vendor-*.ts; FAIL if any non-vendor http handler (auth.ts/processes.ts/inbox.ts/audit.ts/rights.ts/grants.ts/org.ts) references activation/entitlement/verifyKey. (AC-8)

fitness_functions.rule: Installer idempotency + config discipline: install.sh must not regenerate an existing .env.prod and must not duplicate the genesis seed on re-run; .env.prod stays gitignored; secrets generated only when missing.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh step (static): grep install.sh guards `.env.prod` with an existence test before generation (no unconditional overwrite); grep it uses `openssl rand` only under the missing-secret branch; assert .env.prod and config/activation/*.key are in .gitignore. Dynamic half (CI integration, AC-4): run installer twice on the same volume, assert second run exit 0 and `git diff`/row-count of genesis seed unchanged. (AC-3/AC-4/AC-11)

fitness_functions.rule: Offline end-to-end works: a circuit started with NO activation key (or an expired one) and NO control-plane connectivity completes 'genesis-owner login -> create process/task -> audit write' fully.
fitness_functions.ci_check: CI integration job (ci.yml): bring the stack up via install.sh with CHOROS_ACTIVATION_KEY unset and no egress to a control-plane; assert GET /health 200, then the seeded e-owner can authenticate, create a process instance, and an audit/actor_event row is written. All green => autonomous mode is fully functional. (AC-7)

fitness_functions.rule: Genesis-owner present exactly once after install: one genesis role_assignment, e-owner has tenant-owner with >=17 delegable mgmt grants — via migration 026 only.
fitness_functions.ci_check: CI integration job: after install.sh, SELECT count(*) FROM choros.role_assignment WHERE source='genesis' == 1 AND count of grants on tenant-owner role >= 17. (AC-2)

fitness_functions.rule: Preflight fail-closed: when a default port is occupied or `docker compose` is absent, install.sh exits != 0 BEFORE any `compose up`, printing the failing precondition; the stack is not brought up.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh step (static): grep install.sh runs all preflight port/binary/disk checks before the first `docker compose ... up` line (ordering check). Dynamic half (CI): occupy port 3000, run install.sh, assert exit != 0 and no containers created. (AC-5)

fitness_functions.rule: Key signature is genuinely verified: a payload whose signature does not match the shipped vendor public key yields state 'invalid' and is rejected as identity/entitlement, but the circuit itself stays up (no core effect).
fitness_functions.ci_check: vitest unit (src/__tests__/vendor/activation.test.ts): verifyKey on a tampered payload => state 'invalid'; on an expired-but-validly-signed key => 'autonomous'; on a valid in-term key => 'active' with circuit_id+entitlements. Plus assert (via FF-T127-1) that none of these states reach core. (AC-9)

fitness_functions.rule: Structured success summary: on success install.sh prints endpoint, first-owner login, version, and activation status (active|autonomous).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/genesis-installer.sh step: grep install.sh's success path emits all four fields (endpoint, owner-login, version, activation status). Manual confirmation per AC-10. (AC-10)

runtime_target: MVP: online, linux/amd64. Installer runs from a terminal on a clean target host with Docker + `docker compose` v2 preinstalled (founder home-server class, /srv/choros via Tailscale; E0.7 owns TLS/proxy). Stack = existing docker-compose.yml + docker-compose.prod.yml; app/key-verifier = node:20 (zero-dep node:crypto Ed25519). Self-upgrade is online (docker compose pull). Air-gapped (preloaded images) and ARM64 are Stage-2, explicitly out of MVP per founder decision 2026-06-13.
